about.description: SKHYB is a single-stock perpetual listed on Delta Exchange India, tracking SK hynix Inc. ADR, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Delta Exchange India prices this market off the Binance bStock token for SK hynix Inc. ADR, a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
